facts.content: Patient complains of a headache.
facts.source_text: CC: Headache

facts.content: The headache onset was yesterday mid-morning, located on the left posterior occipital side, described as throbbing.
facts.source_text: HPI: Onset yesterday mid-morning; left posterior (occipital) side; throbbing

facts.content: The headache gradually built over a short period and is rated 8/10 in severity.
facts.source_text: throbbing; gradual build over short period; 8/10

facts.content: The headache is not positional, there is no diurnal variation, and the patient slept OK.
facts.source_text: not positional; no diurnal variation; slept OK

facts.content: Nurofen (ibuprofen) taken yesterday did not relieve the headache.
facts.source_text: Nurofen (ibuprofen) yesterday without relief

facts.content: No prior history of headaches reported.
facts.source_text: no prior headaches

facts.content: The headache is impacting work and activities of daily living.
facts.source_text: impacting work/ADLs

facts.content: Patient denies nausea, vomiting, focal numbness, weakness, tingling, blurred vision, photophobia, fever, chills, sweats, and rash.
facts.source_text: ROS: Denies N/V, focal numbness/weakness, tingling, blurred vision, photophobia, fever/chills/sweats, rash

facts.content: No past medical history reported.
facts.source_text: PMH: None reported

facts.content: No routine medications.
facts.source_text: Meds: None routinely

facts.content: Ibuprofen was used yesterday.
facts.source_text: ibuprofen yesterday

facts.content: Mother has hypertension and migraines.
facts.source_text: FH: Mother HTN, migraines

facts.content: Patient lives with a partner and works as a designer.
facts.source_text: SH: Lives with partner; designer

facts.content: Patient is a non-smoker and does not consume alcohol or recreational drugs.
facts.source_text: non-smoker; no etOH; no recreational drugs

facts.content: Acute unilateral throbbing headache located at the left occipital side, new-onset, 8/10 in severity, with no red flags.
facts.source_text: Acute unilateral throbbing headache (left occipital), new-onset, 8/10, no red flags

facts.content: Poor response to ibuprofen, with family history suggesting migraine. Consistent with primary headache.
facts.source_text: Poor response to ibuprofen. FH migraine. c/w primary headache (migraine without aura vs tension-type).

facts.content: A trial of alternate NSAID is recommended, to be taken regularly with food, with the possible addition of paracetamol.
facts.source_text: Analgesia: Trial alternate NSAID (instead of ibuprofen), take regularly with food; may add paracetamol

facts.content: Rest and hydration are advised.
facts.source_text: Rest and hydration advised

facts.content: Patient advised to seek care if pain worsens or if new symptoms occur.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: Seek care if worsening pain, new sx (fever, rash, vomiting, neck stiffness), or recurrent similar episodes

facts.content: Call back for reassessment if no improvement within 1–2 days after starting medication.
facts.source_text: Follow-up: If not improving within 1–2 days after starting medication, call back for reassessment
